scope: Knowledge namespace roots and explicit export policy over existing resource ACLs, plus HTTP/SDK configuration surface

regression.scope: I026 suite (647) + namespace catalog tests (15) + namespace HTTP/SDK tests (7), not full repository

verified: Registered roots reopen from durable SQLite registry and resolve canonical URI/reference binding
Read/write permission on a source does not implicitly authorize cross-namespace export; explicit export edge required
Group membership and one-way export edges are respected; export change invalidates an issued ticket, idempotent grant does not
Source/target ACL revocation is observed even while the export edge remains
More permissive child ACL does not bypass Wiki root membership
Authorization ticket cannot be reused by another actor/group context or across accounts with the same URI
Registration requires enabled ACLs, a restricted root ACL, an existing directory root, and disjoint roots
Root registration order: ACL-enabled gate, directory gate, overlap conflict, then restricted-ACL gate; a file URI root fails as a precondition rather than an overlap conflict
HTTP /api/v1/kb/namespaces register/get and /{source_namespace}/exports route to NamespaceCatalog with strict request models
Async and sync SDK expose register_namespace/get_namespace/set_export over the same HTTP routes and result contract
Overlap conflict maps to HTTP 409 CONFLICT; file-URI root maps to HTTP 412 FAILED_PRECONDITION; extra/typed-bad fields are rejected 422
Namespace router registered in server/routers/__init__.py and included in app.py
not_implemented: Production business-namespace member grants / ACL projection / independent namespace isolation
Global namespace prefilters, ACL mutation fencing and task identity refresh
Cross-domain export transaction commit/CAS and persistent entity validation catalog
Full FLOW-D1/D2/W1/W2, Wiki build HTTP task entry and shared index publication
Physical GC / plan retirement / lease and crash recovery
Real remote OpenViking/Wiki deployment; this run used disk AGFS and ACL mocks
boundaries: ACL context store and embedding backend are fixtures; not production grants or complete namespace search/commit verification
The router only registers/reads configuration; it does not create namespace membership or ACL grants
I026 five legacy SDK baseline failures remain unfixed; the 669-test run is not a full-repository acceptance
